WaterSubsoil.definition: Amount of water required to hydrate one bag of subsoil per day

WaterTopsoil.definition: Amount of water required to hydrate one bag of topsoil per day

MaxTotalBags.definition: Maximum number of bags of topsoil and subsoil combined

MinTopsoilBags.definition: Minimum number of topsoil bags to be used

MaxTopsoilProportion.definition: Maximum proportion of bags that can be topsoil
